title: Run a procedure of an existing script
summary: Runs a named procedure of a script project or script file from an extension by launching the built-in ScriptingSystem:RunScript process with DXP.Utils.RunCommand; a helper writes a demo script project to try it with.
phrasings: run a DelphiScript procedure from an extension
call a script project from C#
launch a built-in process with parameters

commands.name: RunScript
commands.description: Run a procedure of an existing script. A script or procedure AD cannot find shows a modal error box that blocks AD until OK is clicked
commands.params: ProjectName=<path to a .PrjScr>|FileName=<path to a script file>|ProcName=<procedure identifier, required> (ProjectName or FileName required; both allowed, project form runs first)

commands.name: WriteDemoScript
commands.description: Write a demo script project (RunScriptDemo.PrjScr, RunScriptDemo.pas); deletes an old RunScriptDemo.txt
commands.params: Out=<existing folder, default the temp folder>
